subject: PO issuance and line-item reconciliation for NimbusCloud onboarding
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@nimbuscloud.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: PO number + spend cap for NimbusCloud onboarding

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the quick demo last week — really excited to get Redwood hooked up. Finance needs a Redwood PO number and the initial spend cap before we can finish our internal change-requests and billing setup. Can you confirm the following so we can proceed?

- A formal PO number we can reference on our end for invoices
- Initial monthly spend cap (we proposed $50,000, but can discuss)
- A clear mapping of your product line-item codes to our SKU IDs (we found a mismatch on SKU NIM-API-STD vs what was on the quote)

I attached our completed onboarding form and vendor W9. Also: who should we sign the DocuSign PO with?

Attachments: nimbus_onboarding_form.pdf (onboarding form), W9_Nimbus.pdf (W-9)

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Head of Procurement, NimbusCloud
elena.morales@nimbuscloud.com
+1 (415) 555-0199
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@nimbuscloud.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-15T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: PO number + spend cap for NimbusCloud onboarding

Hi Elena — looping in Procurement (Monica) and Sales Ops (Karthik) so we can land this.

Quick answers up front: we can issue a provisional PO number and set a monthly cap while your billing is being routed. Monica will confirm PO format and next steps.

A few asks to expedite setup:
- Can you confirm the exact SKU list and quantities you expect in month 1 so we can map line-items? (If you have the quote ID, include it.)
- Please send a billing contact and the email that will receive DocuSign.
- We'll need a signed vendor onboarding checklist (I attached our template).

I attached: vendor_onboarding_checklist.xlsx — please fill the highlighted billing fields and send back.

I'll stand by to approve the provisional PO once Monica confirms the spend cap.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@nimbuscloud.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-16T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: PO number + spend cap for NimbusCloud onboarding

Hi Elena / Markus,

Thanks — reviewed the onboarding form. We can issue a provisional PO and set the initial monthly cap while accounting sets up the vendor record. Details below:

- Provisional PO number (issued): RWI-2026-0451 (please reference this on invoices and internal tickets)
- Initial monthly spend cap: $50,000 USD (can be revisited after month 1 usage review)
- Corrected line-item mapping:
  * Nimbus quote SKU NIM-API-STD -> Redwood product code RWI-SVC-API-M (unit: request/hr)
  * Nimbus quote SKU NIM-ENT-ADDTL -> Redwood product code RWI-SVC-ADD (unit: seat/month)
  * Please confirm any add-on SKUs that differ — we found NIM-LOG-XL mapped to RWI-OBS-LOG after a small SKU rename; use RWI obs code on invoices.

I've uploaded a PO stub to this thread (PO_RWI-2026-0451.pdf) and generated a DocuSign envelope for your signature: https://docusign.net/ABC1234-Nimbus-PO

Next steps for Nimbus: sign DocuSign (billing contact), return filled vendor_onboarding_checklist.xlsx, and confirm month-1 expected usage/quantity so we can finalize line-item rates.

If Nimbus needs the cap increased before month-end, please request in writing — we'll route to Finance and Leadership for approval.

-Monica
Monica Patel
Manager, Procurement Operations, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@nimbuscloud.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Elena Morales <elena.morales@nimbuscloud.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-16T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: PO number + spend cap for NimbusCloud onboarding

Thanks Monica — received. A couple quick asks from our side: 

1) Can we provisionally increase the month-1 cap to $75,000? We expect a higher onboarding ramp and want to avoid throttling during test migration.
2) Can you provide a per-line-item dollar estimate (not just codes) for the initial quantities? If you can drop a short line-item estimate in the PO PDF or a table, that would help our FP&A sign-off.

We will sign DocuSign today. Billing contact is finance-ops@nimbuscloud.com.

—Samir
Samir Patel
Finance Manager, NimbusCloud
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-17T17:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: PO issuance and line-item reconciliation for NimbusCloud onboarding

Aditya — heads up. Nimbus signed the DocuSign and asked for a temporary increase to $75k for month 1 to support migration tests. Monica has provisionally issued RWI-2026-0451 at $50k and noted we need Finance approval to bump to $75k.

Recommendation: approve a one-time month-1 buffer (increase to $75k) and schedule a usage review on 2026-06-15 to confirm permanent cap. If approved, Monica will update the PO and billing to reflect the higher cap and append per-line-item estimates to the PO PDF.

Happy to discuss — this looks like a low-risk operational increase to reduce migration friction; Nimbus is strategic for our Marketplace partnership.

Thanks,
Markus
